question:
Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.

One who has lost one’s parents
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 3 i.e. **Orphan'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase** 'One who has lost one’s parents'** describes a person who no longer has living parents.(वह जिसने अपने माता-पिता को खो दिया है)
 
• The word that perfectly substitutes this phrase is** 'Orphan'**. An 'Orphan' is a child whose parents are dead. (अनाथ)

Therefore, the** correct answer **is-** 'Orphan'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 is** 'Recluse', **which means a person who lives a solitary life and tends to avoid others. (वैरागी)
 
• Option 2 is** 'Martyr',** which means a person who is killed because of their religious or other beliefs.(शहीद)
 
• Option 4 is **'Snob',** which means a person with an exaggerated respect for high social position or wealth who seeks to associate with social superiors and dislikes people or activities regarded as lower-class.(घमंडी)
